utterance: Hi Chloe, I see you've booked in because of some burning when you pass urine. Can you tell me a bit more about what's been happening?
reply: It stings and burns, especially at the end when I wee, like my last UTI. I've been going all the time — every half hour or so — but only pass a little each time. It's been happening since yesterday morning, so about a day and a half. The urine is a bit cloudy and smells, but I haven't seen any blood.

utterance: Have you had any fevers, chills, nausea, vomiting, or pain in your back or sides? And have you noticed any vaginal discharge or itching?
reply: No fevers or shivers, and I haven't been sick or felt generally unwell. No pain in my back or sides, just a bit of a tummy ache low down. No vaginal discharge or itching.

Red flag excluded: Nausea, vomiting or feeling generally unwell

utterance: You mentioned this feels like your last UTI. When did you last have one, and how often have you had them in the past year? Also, any new sexual partners recently, or any chance you could be pregnant?
reply: I had a UTI about two years ago and that's the only one I've had. I've been with the same boyfriend for about a year, just him. I don't think I'm pregnant.

awards.label: Red flag excluded: Whether she could be pregnant

utterance: When was your last period, and have you missed any of your contraceptive pills recently? Also, have you taken anything over-the-counter for the burning, and do you have any allergies to medications?
reply: My last period was about two weeks ago and it was normal. I'm on the pill and I don't miss it. I haven't taken anything over-the-counter for the burning, and I'm not allergic to anything that I know of.

finding: Soft. Mild suprapubic tenderness; non-tender elsewhere. No masses or organomegaly.

No renal angle tenderness on either side.

result: Leucocytes ++, nitrites positive, blood trace, protein trace. hCG not tested.

awards.label: First-line antibiotic: nitrofurantoin 100 mg 6-hourly for 5 days, fosfomycin 3 g once, or trimethoprim 300 mg daily for 3 days

utterance: Based on your symptoms and the urine tests we just did, you have an uncomplicated urinary tract infection (UTI), often called cystitis. Your pregnancy test was negative. I've prescribed a 3-day course of an antibiotic called trimethoprim, which you take once a day. You should start to feel better within a day or two. Drink plenty of fluids, and you can get some Ural from the pharmacy to help with the burning. If you develop any fevers, chills, lower back or side pain, nausea or vomiting, or if the symptoms don't improve after 3 days, please come back to see me immediately. Does that sound okay, and do you have any questions?
reply: Yeah, that sounds okay. I'll start the antibiotic today. I just wanted to make sure I wasn't doing anything else wrong. Thanks.

awards.label: Reasonable differential: Urethritis from a sexually transmitted infection
